name: When should interior design start in a custom luxury home build?

mainEntity.name: When should I bring in a luxury interior designer during a custom home build in Los Angeles?
mainEntity.text: When should I bring in a luxury interior designer during a custom home build in Los Angeles?

acceptedAnswer.text: The best time to bring in a luxury interior designer is before the architecture is finalized, not after construction starts. Early involvement helps coordinate room dimensions, sightlines, ceiling heights, lighting placement, kitchen layouts, bath configurations, and built-in details. In Los Angeles, where custom homes often involve complex permitting, hillside conditions, and premium finishes, late design decisions can create expensive delays. An early design team can also help shape the budget realistically, because finish levels, millwork, and specialty materials affect construction costs more than many homeowners expect. If furnishings and custom pieces are part of the plan, early design involvement is even more important because lead times for custom items can be long. The strongest projects use a coordinated process where the architect, builder, and interior designer work together from the beginning, so the finished home feels intentional instead of patched together.
acceptedAnswer.description: Luxury interior design should start as early as possible, ideally during programming and architectural planning. Bringing the designer in before final plans are approved helps coordinate layouts, ceiling details, lighting, cabinetry, and material selections, which reduces redesigns and costly changes later.
